instruction: Male, late 20s-30s, neutral English accent. Calm, intelligent, conversational voice with natural energy. Speaks at a normal everyday pace, never slow or overly deliberate. Clear articulation, warm vocal texture, and short natural pauses. Engaging and easy to follow, with enough momentum to hold attention in short-form videos. Explains complex technical subjects simply and confidently without sounding academic, robotic, or dramatic. Uses natural emphasis and subtle changes in tone to highlight important ideas. Sounds like a knowledgeable creator casually explaining something interesting to the viewer. Ideal for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, machine learning explainers, AI news, software engineering, science, and technology content.
